name: meeting-minutes-trace
description: 转写会议纪要，并按纪要条目回溯到 AssemblyAI 返回的音频时间。未配置 ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY 时不请求、不编造纪要。不是 Whisper，不是腾讯会议，不是飞书。

assemblyai_api_key.title: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
assemblyai_api_key.description: AssemblyAI API key. The host must place this value in ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY before launching scripts/minutes.py. No default. This package does not read config files, does not ask for the key in chat, and does not invent a key.
